title: Lost Mary Maryliq Blueberry Watermelon Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Take your taste buds on a flavour journey with Lost Mary Maryliq's Blueberry Watermelon Lemonade. This sensational e-liquid is a vibrant blend that starts with the succulent sweetness of Blueberries and Watermelon. Just when you think the experience can't get any better, a splash of zingy Lemonade bursts through, invigorating your senses and elevating the vape to a whole new level. Imagine sipping on a chilled glass of fruity lemonade on a hot summer day; that's exactly what this e-liquid delivers in each and every puff. Crafted with a balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, you'll enjoy a smooth throat hit and a flavour-packed vapour cloud. Perfect for vapers who appreciate complex, layered flavours, Blueberry Watermelon Lemonade is a one-way ticket to vape paradise.
